recipe.visualDefinition: A tight studio portrait of a male and female duo against a solid warm orange background, featuring high-contrast 1960s styling and decorative, interlocking display typography centered above the subjects.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects positioned back-to-back with heads turned toward the viewer
Monochromatic background color matching the warm skin tones
Typography floating in the upper third negative space
Contrast between blonde hair texture and dark brunette hair
coreInvariants: High-contrast studio lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The interlocking display text at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold central text down to the female subject's eyes, then across to the male subject's gaze.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the top third to accommodate the title.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in hair and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Creamy white in the typography and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm spectrum with deep, crushed blacks in the shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated swashes and curls on terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Terminals of 'N' and 'L' extending into flourishes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate display type paired with a minimalist, wide-set technical sans-serif.

avoid: Modern geometric sans-serifs for the title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 60s/70s decorative serif feel with large flourishes.
Provides the appropriate vintage weight and unique terminal shapes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a blonde woman and a man with a mustache, back-to-back, looking at the camera. Solid burnt orange background. 1960s film aesthetic, warm lighting, grainy texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large centered title in a decorative cream-colored swash serif font with a thin dark outline. Add a small, wide-spaced technical sans-serif word at the very top center.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, warm orange?
Are the subjects framed from the chest up?
Does the title font feature interlocking swashes?
Is the lighting high-contrast with a vintage film look?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artists

mustAchieve: Balanced negative space at the top

postGenerationChecks: Check for interlocking letterforms in the title
Ensure the orange background is uniform without distracting patterns
Verify the subjects' eyes are sharp and directed at the viewer
Confirm the cream color of the text pops against the orange
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Burnt Orange Backdrop + Victorian-Revival Swash Typography = 1960s Pop Album Aesthetic
